faq.q: What is the weather like for an Estepona boat charter in September 2040?
faq.a: September is golden: average highs of 29°C, sea temperatures of 24–27°C, and only two or three rainy days per month. Winds are light, typically 5–10 knots, making for calm cruising along the coast. It's the last month of the peak season before the autumn lull.

faq.q: How much does an Estepona boat charter cost in September 2040?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. The Mangusta 80 (24m) is priced from €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. For other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a group of 10–12 people?
faq.a: For groups of 10–12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) are ideal. They offer spacious decks, flybridges, and cabins. For a more intimate experience, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a sporty alternative.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs. You just need to bring sunscreen and your swimsuit.

faq.q: Where can we go on a day trip from Estepona?
faq.a: Popular routes include east to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for swimming, or west to Sotogrande for a lunch stop. You can also head south to the Bay of Gibraltar for dolphin spotting. All trips depart from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes by car from Estepona.

faq.q: Is September a good time for snorkeling and water sports?
faq.a: Absolutely. With water visibility often exceeding 10 metres and sea temperatures around 25°C, September is excellent for snorkeling. The Mangusta 80 charter includes a free jet ski, and you can also request paddleboards or towable toys on other boats (subject to availability).

faq.q: How do I book an Estepona boat charter for September 2040?
faq.a: You can book directly through our website or contact us via WhatsApp for personalised quotes. We recommend booking at least two weeks in advance for September, as it's a popular month. A 50% deposit secures your date, with the balance due 7 days before departure.

data.body_html:
September 2040 is the golden month on the Costa del Sol: the summer crowds thin out, the sea stays warm at 24–27°C, and the sky is a near-perfect blue. An Estepona boat charter in September 2040 offers calm seas, 10+ hours of daylight, and the last chance to enjoy peak-season warmth before autumn. Whether you want a fast 2-hour spin or a full-day voyage to Cala Cortés, our fleet of 18 boats from Puerto Banús has you covered.

Why September 2040 Is the Golden Month for an Estepona Boat Charter

September averages 29°C air temperature, with sea breezes keeping things comfortable. Rainfall is minimal — typically just 15mm across the whole month. The water is at its warmest after the summer sun, and the UV index is still high enough for a tan but not scorching. For an Estepona boat charter, this means stable conditions, fewer afternoon thunderstorms, and glassy mornings perfect for cruising at 20+ knots.

Our Fleet for Estepona Boat Charters in September 2040

We operate from Puerto Banús, a 15-minute drive from Estepona. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Here are the top choices for September:

  • Tier A — Budget-friendly: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h to €2,299/8h.
  • Tier B — Jet ski included: Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4h, with a free jet ski.
  • Premium options: Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) — pricing on request.
  • Small groups: Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) for a quick dash.

Browse the full fleet on our homepage for specs and photos.

Pricing for Estepona Boat Charter September 2040

Our pricing is transparent and includes everything. For Tier A boats, a 2-hour charter is €749, 4 hours €1,499, 6 hours €1,899, and 8 hours €2,299. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). All other boats — like the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Pershing 46 — are quoted via WhatsApp. No hidden fees: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA are all included.

Best Destinations for Your September Charter

From Puerto Banús, head west to Estepona’s coast for a swim at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Continue to Sotogrande for a lunch at a beach club, or go south to the Bay of Gibraltar for dolphin watching. Eastwards, you can reach Marbella’s Golden Mile or Cabopino. September’s long daylight (sunrise ~07:30, sunset ~20:30) gives you time for a relaxed itinerary.

What to Pack for a September Boat Trip

Bring sunscreen (SPF 50+), a hat, sunglasses, a light jacket for the evening breeze, and a swimsuit. We provide all drinks and snacks, but you can bring your own food if you prefer. A waterproof phone case is handy for photos. The skipper will handle navigation and safety — just relax.

Book Your Estepona Boat Charter September 2040

September is popular, so book early. Contact us via WhatsApp for personalised quotes on premium yachts, or reserve a Tier A or Tier B boat directly. A 50% deposit secures your date. Check our full September guide for more tips, or explore all boats to find your perfect match.
